rationale: Excluded (E07 wrong service, also failing C2 narrow, C3 empirical design and C4 access outcome). The paper is a high-level regional policy and conceptual overview focused on urban/peri-urban wastewater reuse for informal agricultural irrigation and health-risk reduction at places of reuse in Africa, rather than an empirical study or systematic review of legal or administrative mechanisms governing household or community water or sanitation service access.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the abstract briefly mentions institutional obstacles, decentralization of treatment functions to places of reuse and multi-stakeholder platforms under a broad literal reading of Criterion 2, the record is excluded under both readings because it focuses on wastewater reuse and informal agricultural irrigation rather than household or community water/sanitation service access and presents a non-empirical regional policy overview.

evidence_quotes.quote: Water reuse in Africa: challenges and opportunities
Untreated urban wastewater is polluting water sources throughout SSA changing freshwater irrigation into wastewater irrigation in and around most cities.
The way forward requires a paradigm shift in a) national curricula and the donor community towards appropriate African solutions for wastewater collection, treatment and reuse
